grid.cell_assignment: same frozen grid as parent run

outer_beam_hypothesis.opposite_extreme_definition: LINE18 median signed across-track >= +5500 m AND LINE32 median signed across-track <= -5500 m
outer_beam_hypothesis.contrast_group: all common cells not satisfying opposite_extreme_definition

local_neighborhood.report: distribution of absolute line18-vs-line32 depth differences around each fixed cell, using only parent common cells

interpretation.LOCAL_OUTER_BEAM_CROSSOVER_SUPPORTED: both fixed cells lie at or above empirical 99th percentile of absolute inter-acquisition difference and the opposite-extreme group has materially larger tail differences than contrast; diagnostic association only
interpretation.ISOLATED_LOCAL_OUTLIERS: fixed cells are extreme but opposite-extreme group does not show broader elevation
interpretation.NOT_EXTREME_IN_PARENT_FIELD: either fixed cell is below empirical 95th percentile of absolute difference
interpretation.INSUFFICIENT_OPPOSITE_EXTREME_SUPPORT: opposite-extreme group has fewer than 20 cells
